perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: liquidityRunway
factors.basis: NuScale reported $1.9 billion of cash, cash equivalents and short/long-term investments at Q2 2026, materially expanding financial runway for commercialization work.

risks: Liquidity strength does not itself demonstrate project orders, construction starts or economic deployment.
unknowns: Timing and economics of binding customer deployments remain the key commercialization unknowns.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: commercialReadiness
factors.basis: NuScale states it has more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners and over 30 executed agreements, while Q2 revenue declined year over year because RoPower FEED Phase 2 work completed in late 2025 with no comparable 2026 activity.

risks: Current-period revenue contraction underscores the gap between technical/supply-chain readiness and recurring commercial project revenue.
contradictions: Strong liquidity and claimed supply-chain readiness coexist with lower year-over-year revenue after prior project engineering work ended.
unknowns: No new binding deployment revenue schedule was established by this source.

facts: NuScale ended Q2 2026 with $1.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short/long-term investments.
Q2 revenue decreased by $8.0 million year over year, primarily because RoPower FEED Phase 2 services completed in late 2025 had no comparable 2026 activity.
R&D expense increased $6.6 million year over year, primarily from higher NPM component readiness/design-maturity activity.
NuScale reported more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners and over 30 executed agreements.

result: Current primary evidence adds liquidity, supply-chain and revenue-transition facts without treating readiness claims as deployment proof.
